name: Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive
paste:
DAVCO 4 IN 1 GROUT ADDITIVE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive, August 2022, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/davco-4-in-1-groutadditive.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2022, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description.
    - Concentrated grout additive designed to increase the flexibility, strength and water resistance of cement based grouts.
    - Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive is suitable for interior and exterior domestic applications. Ideal for submerged and high foot traffic areas, where a high degree of deformability is required.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - To reduce the porosity of cement based grouts
    - To improve the compressive strength of cement based grouts
    - To improve the flexural strength of cement-based grouts
    - Suitable for use when grouting over fibre cement sheet floors and swimming pools or where a greater performance level / heavy duty performance is required
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2022, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Increases flexibility, strength and water resistance of cement based grout
    - Enhances the colour of grout
    - Reduced likelihood of efflorescence
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: White liquid, dries clear.
    - Specific gravity: 1.0kg/L
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - Specification for V2 IEQ-13, V1.1 IEQ-11
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Flash point: Non Flammable
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Available in a 1Ltr r 5Ltr Jerry can
    - Shelf life: If unopened 12 months from date of manufacture.
    - Storage conditions: Store off ground in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (August 2022, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2022, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive must be diluted with clean, potable water at a ratio of 1:1 for use as an additive in cement based grouts. Thoroughly mix the required amount of 4 in 1 Grout Additive and water together as per the following:
    | Grout | Davco 4 in 1 additive | Water |
    | Davco Elite G10 Grout | 125ml | 125ml |
    | 1kg |
    | Davco Superfine White | 125ml | 125ml |
    | Grout 1kg |
    | Davco Sanitized Color- | 125ml | 125ml |
    | grout 1kg |
    | Davco Slate n Quarry | 100ml | 100ml |
    | Grout 1Kg |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test the product in an inconspicuous area first for colour matching
    - Do not use in temperatures above 35°C or below 5°C
    - Do not allow the product to freeze Specific
    - Not suitable for areas where high chemical and stain resistance is required use a suitable Sika Epoxy Grout
    - Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive will make the grout a slightly darker shade than when mixed with clean potable water
    - For natural stone and course surface applications, it is recommended to reseal the tile surface before grouting Note: Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive will increase the tackiness of the grout as well as reduce the pot life, open time, work time and final clean up time
    - For situations not mentioned in this technical data sheet, contact Sika Australia

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - Do not use in temperatures above 35°C or below 5°C
    - Do not allow the product to freeze Specific
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test the product in an inconspicuous area first for colour matching
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive, August 2022, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/davco-4-in-1-groutadditive.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Various Semi-Finished, version 29/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/sds-various-semi-finished.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive, version 29/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sds-davco-4-in-1groutadditive.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Grout mix process. 1. Add the required amount of Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive and water mixture into a clean bucket. 2. Slowly add the powder to the liquid while mixing by hand or with a mixing paddle attached to a drill. 3. Continue to mix for several minutes until a toothpaste-like consistency is achieved, free of lumps of powder. 4. Allow mixture to stand for 5 minutes, remix then use the grout.
    - Do not add any additional water during the potlife of the grout, restir only without adding water.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Application.
    - The grout should be applied as per the instructions for the grout, including joint shaping and clean up, refer to the relevant product datasheet for the grout.
    - Once the grout has sufficiently hardened, the tiles should be polished with a dry cloth. Ensure the face of the tiles are cleaned and polished within 4-6 hours
    - For difficult to remove areas, it is recommended to use Davco Sanitized® Tile and Grout Cleaner
6.4 Ecology, health and safety - Cleaning of tools.
    - Clean tools and equipment with water before the grout dries.
6.5 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.6 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.7 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
